subject: Mathematics
chapterName: Chapter 1: Applications of Matrices and Determinants

videos.title: Topic 1.1: Row Echelon Form Lecture
videos.description: Comprehensive lecture explaining elementary row operations, leading non-zero entries, and transforming matrices to Row Echelon Form.

videos.title: Topic 1.2: Rank of a Matrix Lecture
videos.description: Step-by-step video lecture on computing rank of rectangular and square matrices using row echelon reduction.

videos.title: Topic 1.3: Inverse of a Non-Singular Matrix Lecture
videos.description: Detailed walkthrough of determinants, adjugate matrix calculation, and matrix inversion formulas.

videos.title: Topic 1.4: Systems of Linear Equations Lecture
videos.description: Solving linear equation systems using Matrix Inversion Method (X = A⁻¹B) and Cramer's Rule.

videos.title: Topic 1.5: Gaussian Elimination Method Lecture
videos.description: Mastering Gaussian elimination with back-substitution for multi-variable linear systems.

videos.title: Topic 1.6: Consistency of Non-Homogeneous Equations
videos.description: Applying Rouché-Capelli theorem to test consistency and classify unique, infinite, or zero solutions.

videos.title: Topic 1.7: Homogeneous Linear Equations Lecture
videos.description: Analyzing homogeneous systems AX = 0, trivial vs non-trivial solutions, and condition det(A) = 0.

videos.title: Video 8: Ex 1.1 Elementary Operations & Echelon Form
videos.description: Detailed video walkthrough of elementary row operations and converting 3x3 matrices to row echelon form.

videos.title: Video 9: Ex 1.1 Practice Problems 1 to 10
videos.description: Step-by-step video solutions for Exercise 1.1 questions 1 through 10.

videos.title: Video 10: Ex 1.1 Advanced Problems 11 to 15
videos.description: Worked video solutions covering higher-order matrix rank problems and inverse calculations.

videos.title: Video 11: Ex 1.2 Rank Computation & Algorithms
videos.description: Video lecture demonstrating rank computation methods for rectangular and singular matrices.

videos.title: Video 12: Ex 1.3 Adjugate & Matrix Inversion
videos.description: Solving matrix inverse problems step-by-step using minor determinants and adjugate formulas.

videos.title: Video 13: Ex 1.5 System Solving & Applications
videos.description: Complete video tutorial on applying Gaussian elimination to real-world word problems.

videos.title: Video 14: Ex 1.6 Consistency & Non-Homogeneous Systems
videos.description: Analyzing system consistency with augmented matrices [A|B] and parameter-dependent solutions.

videos.title: Video 15: Ex 1.7 Homogeneous Systems & Non-Trivial Solutions
videos.description: Determining conditions for non-trivial solutions in homogeneous systems AX = 0.
